mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and stimulates corporate investment.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal robust economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS and RSAFS both rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDP growth > 2% and unemployment < 4.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening real estate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, a HOUST decline fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that increases wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between UNRATE and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0%, it signals an overheated labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflation, eroding corporate profit margins and increasing the risk of monetary tightening, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL rising and INDPRO falling fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regimes (GDP growth > 3% and INDPRO > 100), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-pandemic recovery periods, an INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
